verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Bevy is a code-first, plugin-based ECS engine without a built-in editor to extend—community commentary explicitly notes Bevy lacks an editor like Godot's ('I think one thing that would sell this would be an editor like Godot has'). While Bevy's plugin/ECS architecture theoretically enables custom tooling, there is no documentation of editor scripting APIs, editor plugin systems, or scene/asset manipulation tools built specifically for extending an editor.
